title: Notes - disappointment after YEARS of reliability
body:
I’ve been using notes since day 1, almost 15yrs, across many devices, multiple accounts, never had a problem.
Last week (November 2024) - the app started closing and crashing on me in the middle of using it while making a scan so I had to download a different app to finish the task. What is worse, my all time go to notes HAVE VANISHED!!!! DISAPPEARED!!!
These are notes I use for filling in forms and data and always use the search bar and it just comes up so I can copy paste. All these are gone and app was closing and crashing on me mid-search.
Huge disappointment, apple!

title: Takmer perfektné
body:
Denne používam túto appku, či už na zapisovanie vysokoškolských poznámok alebo na osobné poznámky. Je jednoduchá, rýchla, prehľadná. Takmer okamžite sa synchronizuje na všetkých zariadeniach.

Medzi zápory by som radil nemožnosť úpravy rozmerov strany. Uvítal by som aj jednoduchší spôsob zafarbenia textu a celkovo o niečo viac funkcií čo sa týka úpravy textu.
